topic: Azathioprine in rheumatic disease: TPMT testing, dosing, bone marrow suppression

source.title: Clinical Pharmacogenetics Implementation Consortium Guideline for Thiopurine Dosing Based on TPMT and NUDT15 Genotypes: 2018 Update
source.whyItFits: CPIC states azathioprine dosing from TPMT and NUDT15 genotypes and the myelosuppression risk in poor metabolizers. It explicitly extrapolates pharmacokinetic dosing to non-malignant immunologic disorders, which includes rheumatic use. NICE Crohn's guidance that mentions thiopurines was rejected as the wrong disease.
